retell: Maya needs to update a model, memo and deck for a board pack. The chatbot gives instructions and a replacement deck, but she carries the edits across herself and sends a slide containing an old number. She replays the task in Agentic Office, which proposes edits inside the same files and lets her accept them. Agentic Office promises that the AI drives while she approves, although I cannot explain where the €74.6m figure came from.
